name: Strong Girl Nam-soon
description: Gifted with superhuman strength, a young woman returns to Korea to find her birth family — only to be entangled in a drug case that could test her power.

videos.title: Birth of the Strong Girl
videos.overview: Desperate for a reunion, Hwang Geum-ju seemingly finds her long-lost daughter. After discovering the truth, Gang Nam-soon prepares for her trip to Korea.

videos.title: Gangnam, Here I Come
videos.overview: Nam-soon begins her search for her parents in Korea but experiences some roadblocks. Geum-ju suspects something's off with her newfound daughter.

videos.title: Three Generations
videos.overview: The incident at the Han River puts a spotlight on Nam-soon. As Kang Hee-sik spends more time with Nam-soon, he connects the dots about her family.

videos.title: Reunion
videos.overview: After a dramatic reunion, Nam-soon becomes closer to her family. As Hee-sik continues to investigate a drug case, Nam-soon lends her assistance.

videos.title: Vigilante of Seoul
videos.overview: As Nam-soon assists Hee-sik in his drug investigation, she has a run-in with the ominous Ryu Si-o. Ri Hwa-ja plots her revenge against Nam-soon.

videos.title: Mystery X
videos.overview: Hee-sik witnesses the jarring effects of the drug when it strikes his team leader. Nam-soon's search for evidence garners attention from foes.

videos.title: Moonbow
videos.overview: Geum-ju pays a strategic visit to Si-o, who has his own motives. During a birthday dinner, Nam-soon's family questions her growing kinship with Hee-sik.

videos.title: Light and Shadow of Gangnam
videos.overview: Hee-sik begins to worry about Nam-soon after Si-o promotes her into his inner circle. Geum-ju probes deeper into a suspicious businessman.

videos.title: The Root of Vice
videos.overview: Nam-soon pulls off a bold heist, putting Si-o on high alert. During a tense meeting, Geum-ju challenges Si-o — who in return begins plotting his revenge.

videos.title: The Stand-ins
videos.overview: Geum-ju falls victim to Si-o's attack but proves she's one step ahead of him. As Nam-soon finally tracks down the drugs, her brother succumbs to them.

videos.title: Breaking Point
videos.overview: The drug infiltrates Nam-soon's family — prompting a search of the source and an antidote. A mourning Hee-sik furiously goes after Si-o's inner circle.

videos.title: Diamond Cuts Diamond
videos.overview: Si-o learns of Geum-ju's ruse and decides to expand his target. As the drug case becomes more intense, Hee-sik asks Nam-soon to move in with him.

videos.title: Save the Sea Hares
videos.overview: To find out Nam-soon's identity, Si-o narrows down his search and goes after her family. Hee-sik faces harsh discipline after news of the drug goes wide.

videos.title: Forewarned Bloodbath
videos.overview: Si-o vows revenge after discovering the truth about Nam-soon. While Hee-sik continues his investigation, Nam-soon and her family go on a trip to Busan.

videos.title: Strong Girl Nam-soon
videos.overview: Mourning the loss of Hwa-ja, Nam-soon directly challenges Si-o. But he refuses to lose, forcing her to endure incredible pain to save her adopted mother.

videos.title: In the Name of Love and Justice
videos.overview: With Nam-soon on the brink of death — Hee-sik rushes to find an antidote. Nam-soon faces Si-o once again but witnesses a surprising turn.
